name: Marcial
site: ckw.ch · Energy and building services, Switzerland
headline: Turn CKW’s usage data into contracts that stay.
saw: Your homepage leads with solar power, bills and tariffs, a solar offer request and further products and services, and shows every visitor the same page whether they are a household or a business.

Once a customer has a contract, their consumption and tariff questions are the strongest signals you own for the next offer and the next cancellation. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.
Cross-sell, upsell and anti churn campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. A household that is about to leave this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Churn signals per customer from consumption changes, tariff questions and support contacts. The right offer, channel and moment, picked for each household and business, and tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the add-on that fits each customer
cases.text: Next best product per customer, such as Photovoltaik, Wärmepumpen or Elektromobilität advice, triggered by what they already consume. No more blanket mails to customers who already run a solar system.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep customers active in your digital channels
cases.text: Personal nudges in email, web and newsletter to check consumption, book Solar advice or come back to CKW, timed to when each customer is most likely to respond.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
